source_text:
PROD Sales Overview: SAP Fiori != Databricks

баг по отчёту Sales Overview на PROD.

в SAP Fiori app 'Manage Sales Orders' (CDS C_SALESORDER_Q1) за март revenue = 1.31M.
в Databricks mart.fact_orders за тот же период 1.24M.
Power BI Sales_Overview_v3.pbix показывает 1.24M (как DBX).

спека SPEC-FIN-014 v1.3 — financial analyst Maria B.
report developer Anna K.
Data Pull: Dmytro S.

надо сверить SAP vs Databricks vs PBI vs спеку. похоже проблема на этапе Data Pull (SAP→Databricks).

label.summary: PROD Sales Overview: SAP Fiori revenue disagrees with Databricks

reconciliation.notes: Fiori 1.31M vs DBX/PBI 1.24M — likely SAP→Databricks load

repro_steps: open Manage Sales Orders in SAP Fiori for March
compare SUM to mart.fact_orders and Sales_Overview_v3.pbix on PROD

deployment.notes: No deploy progress in ticket; rule is DEV → FA approve → PROD
